sources.snippet: SR-CorrNet is an asymmetric encoder-decoder with the Separation-Reconstruction (SepRe) strategy on a TF dual-path backbone: the encoder performs coarse separation, the weight-shared decoder progressively reconstructs speaker-discriminative features, and an attractor-based dynamic split adapts the output stream count to the speaker configuration.

sources.title: SR-CorrNet: Time-Frequency Speech Separation
sources.snippet: SR-CorrNet uses time-frequency correlations in an asymmetric encoder-decoder to robustly separate single and multi-channel speech with state-of-the-art ASR performance.
